title: Dark_Cave
lead_summary:
Dark Cave connects Route 31 to Blackthorn City.
The player requires HM08 Flash or the HM Replacement Item to navigate, as well as HM03 Surf or its HM Replacement Item.
The path to Blackthorn City is blocked by a huge boulder and the player will need to collect three sticks of Dynamite from Workers in order to proceed. The workers are located in the three areas marked on the map, but will not appear before the player talks to the man standing in front of the boulder.
